notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a blue nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {U}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact blue permanent with mana cost {U} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
description:
Cast the blue permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Dreams and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Dreams trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The blue permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact blue permanent with mana cost {U} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until you have an empty library.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 7 as many times as desired.
